name: CRUX miters
authors_source: the generator and its README, sent by the author in September 2026
license_note: the generator is not published in a public repository; Armin Biere agreed in September 2026 that it be part of SAT Heritage, and the sources are kept in cruxmiter/upstream with that notice. Ask him before reusing them elsewhere, and before publishing the image
source_repo: sent by the author, kept in cruxmiter/upstream
seed: the second argument; the generator seeds the C library random generator, so the same seed gives the same formula on the same C library
notes: a miter between two trees of bit-vector adders over the same inputs, added in a random order on each side: hard for resolution, and used beyond the competitions, in work on distributed cube and conquer and on tuning for cubing. The chain needs Boolector with the normalisation of adders disabled and the aiger of May 2021: at its default rewriting level Boolector proves the miter away, and a later aigtocnf writes smaller, different formulas
